(file: /logs/agent/skills/.system/plugin-creator/SKILL.md)

import json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path

base=Path('/app/benchmark')
with open(base/'task_input.json') as f:
    task=json.load(f)
with open(base/'source_data.json') as f:
    src=json.load(f)

# Build joined table
sp={d['country']:d for d in src['education_spending']['data']}
pi={d['country']:d for d in src['pisa_scores']['data']}

rows=[]
for c,v in sp.items():
    if c in pi:
        rows.append((c,v['edu_spending_pct_gdp'],pi[c]['pisa_avg']))

# Sort for stable plotting
rows=sorted(rows,key=lambda x:x[1])

countries=[r[0] for r in rows]
x=[r[1] for r in rows]
y=[r[2] for r in rows]

# Determine style
style=(task.get('style') or '').lower()
exec_style='professional'
if style:
    exec_style=style

plt.rcParams.update({
    'figure.dpi':200,
    'font.size':11,
    'axes.titlesize':15,
    'axes.labelsize':11,
    'legend.fontsize':10
})

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,7))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')
ax.set_facecolor('#f7f9fc')

# Professional palette
point_color='#1f77b4'
line_color='#d62728'

ax.scatter(x,y,s=58,color=point_color,alpha=0.9,edgecolors='white',linewidth=0.7,label='Country')

# Trend line
import numpy as np
coef=np.polyfit(np.array(x),np.array(y),1)
poly=np.poly1d(coef)
xx=np.linspace(min(x)-0.1,max(x)+0.1,100)
ax.plot(xx,poly(xx),color=line_color,linewidth=2.2,label='Linear trend')

# Highlight notable points for story clarity
for c,xi,yi in rows:
    if c in {'Singapore','Japan','Costa Rica','Greece'}:
        ax.annotate(c,(xi,yi),xytext=(5,5),textcoords='offset points',fontsize=9,color='#2f2f2f')

ax.set_title('Higher Public Education Spending Is Associated with Better PISA Performance')
ax.set_xlabel('Public education spending (% of GDP)')
ax.set_ylabel('PISA 2022 average score (points)')
ax.grid(True,which='major',linestyle='--',alpha=0.25)

# Correlation for legend insight
corr=float(np.corrcoef(x,y)[0,1])
ax.legend(title=f'30 countries • Pearson r = {corr:.2f}',loc='lower right',frameon=True)

# Footnote-like source traceability
fig.text(0.01,0.01,'Source: /app/benchmark/source_data.json (education_spending + pisa_scores, joined on country)',fontsize=8,color='#555')

out=Path('/app/output/result.png')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0,0.03,1,1])
plt.savefig(out,format='png')
print(out)
PY

python - <<'PY'
import json, math
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

base=Path('/app/benchmark')
with open(base/'task_input.json') as f:
    task=json.load(f)
with open(base/'source_data.json') as f:
    src=json.load(f)

goal=task.get('goal')
if isinstance(goal,list):
    goal_text=' '.join(str(x) for x in goal)
else:
    goal_text=str(goal or '')

sp={d['country']:d for d in src['education_spending']['data']}
pi={d['country']:d for d in src['pisa_scores']['data']}
rows=[]
for c,v in sp.items():
    if c in pi:
        rows.append((c,float(v['edu_spending_pct_gdp']),float(pi[c]['pisa_avg'])))
rows.sort(key=lambda t:t[1])

# canvas
W,H=1600,1000
m_left,m_right,m_top,m_bottom=130,80,120,130
plot_w=W-m_left-m_right
plot_h=H-m_top-m_bottom

img=Image.new('RGB',(W,H),'white')
d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# fonts
try:
    f_title=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf',42)
    f_sub=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',24)
    f_axis=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',22)
    f_tick=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',18)
    f_leg=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',20)
    f_note=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',16)
except:
    f_title=f_sub=f_axis=f_tick=f_leg=f_note=ImageFont.load_default()

# colors professional
c_bg='#ffffff'; c_plot='#f6f8fb'; c_axis='#334155'; c_grid='#dbe4ee'; c_pts='#1f77b4'; c_line='#d62728'; c_text='#0f172a'

d.rectangle([0,0,W,H],fill=c_bg)
d.rectangle([m_left,m_top,W-m_right,H-m_bottom],fill=c_plot)

xvals=[r[1] for r in rows]; yvals=[r[2] for r in rows]
xmin,xmax=min(xvals),max(xvals)
ymin,ymax=min(yvals),max(yvals)
# padding
dx=(xmax-xmin)*0.08; dy=(ymax-ymin)*0.08
xmin-=dx; xmax+=dx; ymin-=dy; ymax+=dy


def sx(x): return m_left + (x-xmin)/(xmax-xmin)*plot_w
def sy(y): return m_top + (ymax-y)/(ymax-ymin)*plot_h

# grid + ticks
for i in range(6):
    xv=xmin+(xmax-xmin)*i/5
    px=sx(xv)
    d.line([(px,m_top),(px,H-m_bottom)],fill=c_grid,width=1)
    lbl=f'{xv:.1f}'
    tw=d.textlength(lbl,font=f_tick)
    d.text((px-tw/2,H-m_bottom+10),lbl,fill=c_axis,font=f_tick)
for i in range(7):
    yv=ymin+(ymax-ymin)*i/6
    py=sy(yv)
    d.line([(m_left,py),(W-m_right,py)],fill=c_grid,width=1)
    lbl=f'{yv:.0f}'
    tw=d.textlength(lbl,font=f_tick)
    d.text((m_left-15-tw,py-10),lbl,fill=c_axis,font=f_tick)

# axes
d.line([(m_left,m_top),(m_left,H-m_bottom)],fill=c_axis,width=3)
d.line([(m_left,H-m_bottom),(W-m_right,H-m_bottom)],fill=c_axis,width=3)

# regression
n=len(rows)
mx=sum(xvals)/n; my=sum(yvals)/n
num=sum((x-mx)*(y-my) for x,y in zip(xvals,yvals))
den=sum((x-mx)**2 for x in xvals)
b1=num/den if den else 0
b0=my-b1*mx

def yhat(x): return b0+b1*x
x1,x2=min(xvals),max(xvals)
p1=(sx(x1),sy(yhat(x1))); p2=(sx(x2),sy(yhat(x2)))
d.line([p1,p2],fill=c_line,width=4)

# points
for c,x,y in rows:
    px,py=sx(x),sy(y)
    r=7
    d.ellipse([px-r,py-r,px+r,py+r],fill=c_pts,outline='white',width=2)

# key labels
for c in {'Singapore','Japan','Costa Rica','Greece'}:
    for cc,x,y in rows:
        if cc==c:
            px,py=sx(x),sy(y)
            d.text((px+8,py-24),c,fill=c_text,font=f_tick)

# correlation
sxm=math.sqrt(sum((x-mx)**2 for x in xvals))
sym=math.sqrt(sum((y-my)**2 for y in yvals))
r=num/(sxm*sym) if sxm and sym else 0

# titles and labels
title='Education Spending vs Student Performance (PISA)'
subtitle='30-country comparison; each dot is one country'
d.text((m_left,30),title,fill=c_text,font=f_title)
d.text((m_left,78),subtitle,fill='#475569',font=f_sub)

xlab='Public education spending (% of GDP)'
xtw=d.textlength(xlab,font=f_axis)
d.text((m_left+(plot_w-xtw)/2,H-70),xlab,fill=c_axis,font=f_axis)

ylab='PISA average score (points)'
d.text((25,m_top+plot_h/2),ylab,fill=c_axis,font=f_axis)

# legend
lx,ly=W-520,42
d.rectangle([lx,ly,lx+430,ly+100],fill='white',outline='#cbd5e1',width=2)
d.ellipse([lx+18,ly+22,lx+34,ly+38],fill=c_pts,outline='white',width=2)
d.text((lx+45,ly+18),'Country',fill=c_text,font=f_leg)
d.line([(lx+18,ly+67),(lx+34,ly+67)],fill=c_line,width=4)
d.text((lx+45,ly+55),f'Linear trend (Pearson r = {r:.2f})',fill=c_text,font=f_leg)

note='Source: /app/benchmark/source_data.json (education_spending + pisa_scores, joined on country).'
d.text((m_left,H-32),note,fill='#64748b',font=f_note)

out=Path('/app/output/result.png')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
img.save(out,'PNG')
print(out)
